photos.title: Holiday Sands South from above
photos.what: Holiday Sands South from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the gray-roofed condo tower stands on the oceanfront at the label; a taller white-roofed building stands to its north-east; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Holiday Sands South from above. The dot marks the middle of the county's parcel for the condos. The other buildings in the frame are not labelled.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the oceanfront in Myrtle Beach with a dot and the label Holiday Sands South at the middle of the condo parcel, the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/holiday-sands-south/ on 2026-11-14. The label dot sits on the gray-roofed tower at the middle of the county's parcel box for the condo regime (box about 88 m a side, the width of the tower and its lot). It shows the tower, a white-roofed building to its north-east, a second tower with a dark roof to its south-west, the beach and the Atlantic Ocean. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
